title: PixelitoPack
description: Complete your life with Pixelito Party!
body:
This silly texture pack adds many things from Pixelito Party -a friendly Discord community-, such as the Megatonto Warden, custom-made music tracks and a mind-blowingly, jaw-dropping End Poem.
![Composition that contains plenty of the PixelitoPack features, like paintings, mobs and particles.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95aa6fd9219e08bb6a12140b7c28dcda566888c3.png)

### Thanks to:
- **AngelMCA** for the music!
- **Lorololland**, **ElJuan123**, **Olimpo**, **Carde**, **Enr1Cat** and **Emmeh** for contributing with some textures!
